surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction products were characterized by solid-state NMR, and these agreed well with a calculated model. When the silica was pretreated to 350 /C176C, the precursor appeared to chemisorb primarily through the loss of a Cp ligand, while with a 900 /C176C pretreatment, the chemisorption occurred primarily through a loss of the guanidinate ligand.
